title: Redact a message body after sending
summary: One PATCH with body "" clears a sent message's stored body in SignalWire's records. The empty string is the only value the spec accepts, and only a message in a terminal state is eligible.
scenario: You texted a one-time code and want it gone from SignalWire's stored records

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json PATCH /api/messaging/messages/{message_id}: body required, only "" accepted (body_must_be_empty); eligible states delivered|undelivered|failed, not queued|initiated
sdk: no wrapper for the messaging redact path in 3.0.1; sent through RestClient._http
